mapper.sql: id, user_id AS userId, category_id AS categoryId, title, summary, content_md AS content, content_type AS contentType, cover_image_url AS coverImage, location, weather, mood, visibility AS isPublic, is_top AS isTop, is_essence AS isEssence, status, view_count AS views, like_count AS likesCount, favorite_count AS favoritesCount, comment_count AS commentsCount, created_at AS createTime, updated_at AS updateTime, publish_at AS publishTime
mapper.update: UPDATE content_article SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE content_article SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE content_article SET like_count = GREATEST(like_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE content_article SET favorite_count = favorite_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE content_article SET favorite_count = GREATEST(favorite_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE content_article SET comment_count = comment_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE content_article SET comment_count = GREATEST(comment_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM content_article WHERE status = 1 AND visibility = 2 ORDER BY view_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.tag_name AS tag, COUNT(*) AS count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS content_count FROM content_article c INNER JOIN content_article_tag art_tag ON art_tag.content_id = c.id INNER JOIN content_tag t ON t.id = art_tag.tag_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 1 GROUP BY t.id, t.tag_name ORDER BY count DESC, t.tag_name ASC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT cc.category_name AS category, COUNT(*) AS count, COUNT(*) AS content_count FROM content_article c INNER JOIN content_category cc ON cc.id = c.category_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 1 AND cc.status = 1 GROUP BY cc.id, cc.category_name ORDER BY count DESC, cc.sort_order ASC, cc.category_name ASC

SELECT DISTINCT c.id FROM content_article c INNER JOIN content_article_tag art_tag ON art_tag.content_id = c.id INNER JOIN content_tag t ON t.id = art_tag.tag_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 1 AND t.tag_name = #{tag}

SELECT cc.category_name AS category, COUNT(*) AS count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS content_count FROM content_article c INNER JOIN content_article_tag art_tag ON art_tag.content_id = c.id INNER JOIN content_tag t ON t.id = art_tag.tag_id INNER JOIN content_category cc ON cc.id = c.category_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 1 AND cc.status = 1 AND t.tag_name = #{tag} GROUP BY cc.id, cc.category_name

SELECT t1.tag_name AS tag1, t2.tag_name AS tag2, COUNT(*) AS cooccurrence FROM content_article c INNER JOIN content_article_tag at1 ON at1.content_id = c.id INNER JOIN content_tag t1 ON t1.id = at1.tag_id INNER JOIN content_article_tag at2 ON at2.content_id = c.id INNER JOIN content_tag t2 ON t2.id = at2.tag_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 1 AND t1.id < t2.id GROUP BY t1.id, t1.tag_name, t2.id, t2.tag_name ORDER BY cooccurrence DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_article WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1

SELECT t.tag_name AS tag, COUNT(*) AS count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS content_count FROM content_article c INNER JOIN content_article_tag art_tag ON art_tag.content_id = c.id INNER JOIN content_tag t ON t.id = art_tag.tag_id WHERE c.status = 1 AND c.visibility = 2 GROUP BY t.id, t.tag_name ORDER BY count DESC, t.tag_name ASC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT cc.category_name AS category, COUNT(*) AS count, COUNT(*) AS content_count FROM content_article c INNER JOIN content_category cc ON cc.id = c.category_id WHERE c.status = 1 AND c.visibility = 2 AND cc.status = 1 GROUP BY cc.id, cc.category_name ORDER BY count DESC, cc.sort_order ASC, cc.category_name ASC

SELECT t1.tag_name AS tag1, t2.tag_name AS tag2, COUNT(*) AS cooccurrence FROM content_article c INNER JOIN content_article_tag at1 ON at1.content_id = c.id INNER JOIN content_tag t1 ON t1.id = at1.tag_id INNER JOIN content_article_tag at2 ON at2.content_id = c.id INNER JOIN content_tag t2 ON t2.id = at2.tag_id WHERE c.status = 1 AND c.visibility = 2 AND t1.id < t2.id GROUP BY t1.id, t1.tag_name, t2.id, t2.tag_name ORDER BY cooccurrence DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
